name: Outbound-energy-flow qualifier
summary: An outbound-energy qualifier identifies energy leaving the represented device or boundary.
description: An outbound-energy qualifier identifies energy leaving the represented device or boundary. The arrow’s meaning is relative to a chosen device or system boundary. A converter may export energy through one port while consuming energy at another.
State the boundary and operating mode alongside the diagram. Keep import/export sign conventions consistent with the metering and control documentation.
readingNotes: Define the boundary and the operating condition for which the arrow is meaningful.
Energy-flow direction can differ from the drawing's reference current direction.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Define the boundary and the operating condition for which the arrow is meaningful.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: Energy-flow direction can differ from the drawing's reference current direction.
